entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. To ensure quality service, this call may be recorded. Please say 'Returns' or 'Product Support' to be connected to the right department.
Returns!
Connecting you to a Returns Specialist now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return a VeloBand Pulse. It's just not working out for me and I need to send it back.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-789012.
Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Pulse. It looks like it was delivered 20 days ago.
Yeah, about that. So?
I understand you'd like to return it, but I'm showing that the VeloBand Pulse has a specific 10-day return window. Unfortunately, we are outside of that period.

Ten days? Are you kidding me? That's impossible. Look, this **was a gift** for my partner. Right after I got it, we had a family emergency and were **traveling** for over a week because my father-in-law was in the **hospital**. It was a complete nightmare.
I am very sorry to hear about your family emergency. I can only imagine how stressful that must have been.

It was. And to make things worse, I tried to get on your website last week to start the return, but the **website crashed** on me three times! I couldn't even log in. Nobody puts a 10-day return window on things unless it's buried in the **fine print** where no one can see it.

I can certainly appreciate your frustration, and I apologize for the trouble you had with the website. However, the 10-day policy on the VeloBand Pulse is firm due to hygiene standards for wearable electronics. Since the item was delivered 20 days ago, I am unable to process a refund for it.

Unbelievable. So after a family crisis and your own website not working, you're telling me I'm just stuck with a $150 piece of plastic? This is not how you treat customers. I'll just dispute the charge with my credit card company.

I understand this isn't the answer you were hoping for, and I want to find a fair solution. Please allow me to place you on a brief hold while I review what options I might have available, given the circumstances you've described.
Fine. But this better be good.

Thank you for your patience. I've discussed the situation with my support lead. While a refund to your original payment method is not possible, given the series of unfortunate events and the technical issues you experienced with our site, we can make a one-time exception. We can offer you the full value of the item, $149.99, in the form of store credit.
Store credit... really?
Yes. And for the trouble and inconvenience this has caused you, I'd also like to add an additional $25 credit to your account. That would give you a total of $174.99 to use on any other VeloFit gear.
Oh. Wow. Uh, so... I could get those cycling shoes I was looking at? That would basically cover them.
Absolutely. The credit can be applied to any purchase. I can add it to your account right now if you'd like.
Okay... yeah. That's actually a great solution. Thank you. I was pretty upset there for a minute.

I completely understand. I'm glad we could work this out for you. The credit has been applied to your account, and you should receive an email confirmation shortly. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's it. Thank you so much for your help, Alex. I really appreciate you doing that.
You are very welcome. We hope your family member is recovering well. Thank you for being a VeloFit customer, and have a wonderful day.
